releaseNotesMarkdown:
### open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases (otel/opentelemetry-collector-contrib)

### [`v0.165.0`](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/blob/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md#v01650)

[Compare Source](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/compare/v0.164.0...v0.165.0)

##### 🛑 Breaking changes 🛑

- `extension/asapauthextension`: disable asapauth extension as it's causing an issue w/ go 1.27 ([#​1742](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1742))

##### 🚀 New components 🚀

- `queue_batch`: Add queue_batch processor, eventually to replace batch processor. ([#​1749](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1749))
  See [docs/rfcs/batching-migration.md](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector/blob/main/docs/rfcs/batching-migration.md)
- `receiver/ecs`: Add the [Prometheus ecs_exporter](https://redirect.github.com/prometheus-community/ecs_exporter) as a receiver for Amazon ECS task metrics in otelcol-prometheus distribution. ([#​1741](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1741))
- `receiver/mysqld`: Add the [Prometheus mysqld_exporter](https://redirect.github.com/prometheus/mysqld_exporter) as a receiver for MySQL server metrics in otelcol-prometheus distribution. ([#​1741](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1741))

##### 💡 Enhancements 💡

- `otelcol-prometheus`: Update embedded Prometheus receivers to v0.3.0. ([#​1741](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1741))
- `packaging`: Enable baseline hardening for packaged Collector systemd services. ([#​1690](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1690))
  Applies to otelcol, otelcol-contrib, otelcol-otlp and otelcol-prometheus.
  NoNewPrivileges prevents gaining privileges through file capabilities or
  setuid/setgid programs. Use systemd AmbientCapabilities for required
  capabilities, or configure a service drop-in for deployment-specific needs.

##### 🧰 Bug fixes 🧰

- `packaging`: Skip systemctl commands that need a running systemd when it is not running, e.g. during Docker image builds ([#​1698](https://redirect.github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/issues/1698))
  - The preremove scripts (deb and rpm) only call `systemctl stop` when systemd is running. Otherwise it printed errors when upgrading or removing packages.
  - The rpm postinstall scripts only call `systemctl daemon-reload` and `systemctl try-restart` when systemd is running. Otherwise the %post scriptlet failed when installing or upgrading packages.
